turns.instruction:
Required solver: OpenSees.
Build a two-story spatial steel frame with X span 6 m, two Y spans of 5 m and story heights 3.6 m. Fix all six bases in all six degrees of freedom. The complete appendix supplies Q355 steel (E=206000 MPa, nu=0.3, G=206000/2.6 MPa, density=7850 kg/m^3), solid rectangular columns C1=400x500 mm, X beams BX=300x600 mm and Y beams BY=250x500 mm. Rotate the local section axes by exactly 90 degrees only for the two column lines at Y=0, on both stories: c0-0-1, c1-0-1, c0-0-2 and c1-0-2. Every other column and every beam remains at roll 0. The single load case D contains only a roof-corner force at (6,10,7.2) m with Fx=20 kN and Fy=15 kN. Use OpenSees for first-order linear elastic Euler-Bernoulli static analysis, self weight off. Report ux/uy at that loaded corner, all six local end-force components at both ends of every rotated and unrotated column, all six reaction components at every base, and a member-by-member local-axis record.

Use all public appendices. Report the complete requested numerical table and the required summaries.
